purpose: Teach: 織り/格子/三輪/面影/根強い/坊さん/悔い/実体験

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、伝統の、本気で、絶対、織りもの、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、興味あるわ
lines.en: You know, Aoi—I'm genuinely fascinated by traditional weaving. You absolutely should pursue it.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Leans forward with genuine interest. Pace is unhurried, deliberate. The kind of enthusiasm that comes from real conviction, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵のお店の窓、本気で、絶対、格子柄に、絶対、リフォーム、絶対、考えてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, actually—I've been seriously thinking about redesigning the shop window with a lattice pattern. It would really suit the space.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Eyes drift slightly as if picturing the design. Soft, measured pace. A hint of vulnerability—testing the idea aloud for the first time.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、三輪車、絶対、子供の頃、絶対、乗ったわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、懐かしい
lines.en: Do you remember riding a tricycle at your grandfather's place when we were kids? God, that feels like forever ago.
lines.style: Wistful sigh on the opening. Soft, nostalgic tone. Pace slows like settling into memory. Voice trails gently—not sad, but tender with the distance of time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お祖父さまの、本気で、絶対、面影、絶対、葵、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、感じるわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I see so much of your grandfather in your father, you know. In the way he carries himself.
lines.style: Gentle realization in the voice. Quiet certainty, not hesitant. Slow, observant pace. The kind of thing said to someone you've known long enough to notice these patterns.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の手作りの、本気で、絶対、根強い、絶対、ファン、絶対、いるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You have such devoted regulars, Aoi. People who really care about what you do. That's something to be proud of.
lines.style: Admiring but grounded—not gushing. Steady, warm emphasis on 'devoted.' Pace is calm and reassuring. The sincerity of someone who actually sees the work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お寺の、本気で、絶対、坊さん、絶対、葵のお店、絶対、寄ってくださるのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even the monks from the temple stop by your shop now. That says something, doesn't it?
lines.style: Pleased, almost amazed at the detail. Slight lift in the voice—genuine delight in this observation. Conversational pace, bright but not forced. Genuine affection underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お祖父さまの、絶対、悔いが、絶対、残るって、絶対、お話、絶対、してたわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've mentioned before that your grandfather had regrets about not pursuing traditional work more seriously. You're honoring that somehow, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle reflection, not pushing. Thoughtful, connecting-the-dots tone. Measured pace. Respectful space around the words—letting her feel the weight of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、実体験、絶対、もとに、絶対、お客様に、絶対、お話ししているわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's what makes it real, though. You're drawing from your own experience, sharing something you've actually lived. That's what your customers feel.
lines.style: Affirming and direct. Steady, warm conviction. Pace is unhurried but grounded. Close and intimate—the voice of someone who truly understands what she's doing.
